hypothesis: A fixed central expanded region may increase small-object scale at224; full-field letterboxing retains peripheral context. No central cash work area is asserted.
scope: One TRAIN spatial ablation; no type/legal claim, head/threshold/ROI search or TUNE/HOLDOUT access

geometry.rounding: floor left/top, ceil right/bottom; clamped within image
geometry.fallback: If cropped-video max margin is below0, use full-video result; otherwise crop. Invalid crop geometry fails instead of silently changing protocol.

encoder: Original pinned Microsoft XCLIP weights/config/processor, ordered8-frame windows, FP16 SDPA, local only. Resizing prepared224 images is identity through the original processor.
windows: Original frozen2-second windows/1-second stride and decoded PTS; same frames for both views
fitting: Separate original equal-video positive-point/negative-mean centroids per view inside each leave-one-TRAIN-group-out fold

decision.fallback_ranking_score: max(full,crop) for ROC only; branch-selected point for localization

stop: One preregistered run. Stop on technical failure, deadline or failed useful gate. Preserve original baseline and packs. No alternate crops, thresholds, ROI/head or fusion search after results. Holdout remains closed.
limits: Central region is geometric, not expert-validated cashier or hand area
Cropping can lose peripheral events; letterboxing reduces object size
Original baseline used center crop and is historical only, not the new full-field arm
No semantic type, description, multi-event or evidence-relevance validation
